About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

As our Account Executive, Digital Natives, you will grow Mistral's business with companies building AI-native products across France and Northern Europe. These are engineering-led companies whose products run on models: coding tools, voice agents, document automation, customer support platforms, search, and more. Their buyers are founders, CTOs, and AI engineering leads, and they choose models on performance, cost, reliability, and data residency.

You will be the first member of the Digital Natives team based in Europe. You will own deals end to end, from first conversation through production launch and expansion, working alongside our solutions engineering, product, science, and legal teams.

This role is based in London, with regular travel across the region and to our Paris headquarters.

What You Will Do:

Pipeline development (targeted outbound and qualified inbound):

  • Identify and engage the most promising AI-native companies in your territory, and build relationships with the founders and engineering leaders who select models

  • Qualify and convert inbound interest from teams already building on our API into commercial relationships

Technical evaluation:

  • Guide customers through evaluations of our models on their real workloads, working with our solutions engineers to keep the process fast and the results clear

  • Turn successful evaluations into production usage and long-term commercial agreements

Deal management and closing:

  • Own the commercial cycle end to end: qualification, evaluation, negotiation, and close, together with our legal and solutions teams

  • Manage deals with multiple technical and executive stakeholders on both sides, and keep everyone aligned on timelines and next steps

Account growth:

  • Grow usage within existing customers as they ship new products and features on our models

  • Stay close to customers' roadmaps so Mistral is positioned for their next workload before it reaches production

Working with product and science:

  • Bring customer feedback, usage patterns, and competitive insight back to our product and science teams to inform priorities and the roadmap

  • Connect customers directly with our product and research teams where it accelerates their success

What We're Looking For:

  • 5 to 8 years of sales experience, with a track record of closing deals with startups and scale-ups for a technical product (API, developer tools, infrastructure, or data)

  • Experience selling to technical buyers: founders, CTOs, and engineering leaders

  • Working knowledge of how AI products are built, and the ability to hold a credible conversation about models, evaluation, and deployment with an engineering audience

  • Experience at a fast-growing startup, ideally in AI, developer tools, or infrastructure

  • Comfort with usage-based revenue, where growth comes from what customers ship rather than from a single contract

  • Excellent English and French

  • Strong negotiation and communication skills, and a hands-on, low-ego approach

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

CUBE are a global RegTech business defining and implementing the gold standard of regulatory intelligence for the financial services industry. We deliver our services through intuitive SaaS solutions, powered by AI, to simplify the complex and everchanging world of compliance for our clients. 

 

Why us?

🌍 CUBE is a globally recognized brand at the forefront of Regulatory Technology. Our industry-leading SaaS solutions are trusted by the world’s top financial institutions globally.

🚀 In 2024, we achieved over 50% growth, both organically and through two strategic acquisitions. We’re a fast-paced, high-performing team that thrives on pushing boundaries—continuously evolving our products, services, and operations. At CUBE, we don’t just keep up we stay ahead.

🌱 We believe our future is built by bold, ambitious individuals who are driven to make a real difference. Our “make it happen” culture empowers you to take ownership of your career and accelerate your personal and professional development from day one.

🌐 With over 700 CUBERs across 19 countries spanning EMEA, the Americas, and APAC, we operate as one team with a shared mission to transform regulatory compliance. Diversity, collaboration, and purpose are the heartbeat of our success.

💡 We were among the first to harness the power of AI in regulatory intelligence, and we continue to lead with our cutting-edge technology. At CUBE, You will work alongside some of the brightest minds in AI research and engineering in developing impactful solutions that are reshaping the world of regulatory compliance.

Role Mission

We are building an AI-powered legal research and regulatory compliance tool covering 187 jurisdictions worldwide. We are now validating the component that answers structured regulatory questions, starting with 99 priority jurisdictions. Content will be released for review in five drops between mid-November and 14 December 2026.

We are appointing eight external SMEs to work alongside our nine internal English-language reviewers. Each SME will cover a defined cluster of jurisdictions and languages.

Validation requires experienced regulatory lawyers and compliance professionals to review AI-generated question-and-answer output, assess its accuracy, completeness, and jurisdictional applicability, and score it against a defined standard. Full training will be provided.

You will act as a specialist reviewer for a defined portfolio of jurisdictions, assessing AI-generated regulatory Q&A outputs (list of relevant content) against the actual regulatory position in each jurisdiction.

We are looking for individuals with knowledge in one or more of the below jurisdictions:

Germany, France, Italy, Austria, Switzerland, Belgium, Luxembourg, Liechtenstein, Monaco, Morocco, Mauritius, Netherlands, Denmark, Norway, Sweden, Finland, Curaçao, Iceland, Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania, Poland, Czech Republic, Hungary, Romania, Slovakia, Croatia, Slovenia, Bulgaria, Serbia, Ukraine, Georgia, Kazakhstan, Saudi Arabia, Israel, Turkey, Greece, Cyprus, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain, Oman, Egypt, Jordan, Japan, China, Hong Kong SAR, South Korea, Taiwan, Macau SAR, India, Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand, Vietnam, Philippines, Brunei, Sri Lanka, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Argentina, Chile, Colombia, Peru, Uruguay, Ecuador, Paraguay, Bolivia, Brazil, Portugal, Mexico, Panama, Costa Rica, Dominican Republic, Puerto Rico, Guatemala

Please note, this is a freelance contract engagement until December 2026, with the possibility of extension.

Responsibilities

  • Review structured regulatory questions and AI-generated answers for your assigned jurisdictions, using your own knowledge of the regulatory framework and authoritative source documents

  • Score each answer across defined dimensions: accuracy, completeness including completeness of sources

  • Work within a structured digital review interface (full training provided: typically a 1–2 hour onboarding session)

  • Communicate progress and blockers to the CUBE Programme Lead within agreed turnaround windows

  • Participate in a re-review cycle for any jurisdictions that do not pass first-time review

  • Maintain strict data-handling standards in line with the NDA and data agreement signed at onboarding

What we're looking for:

  • Qualified lawyer (or equivalent regulatory compliance professional) ideally with a recognised legal qualification in at least one of your assigned jurisdictions, or in the primary legal tradition governing those jurisdictions

  • Minimum 5 years post-qualification experience in financial services regulation, corporate law, or regulatory compliance: with direct experience interpreting and applying regulatory frameworks, not solely advising on them

  • Deep working knowledge of the regulatory environment in your assigned jurisdictions

  • Familiarity with the primary regulatory authorities and their output (e.g. BaFin, AMF, CONSOB, SAMA, FSA Japan, CSRC, CMF, CVM, MAS: depending on your assigned cluster)

  • Experience interpreting and applying regulatory rules across multiple jurisdictions within your cluster; awareness of jurisdictional variation within broadly similar frameworks

  • Understanding of financial services regulatory concepts (reporting obligations, licensing, AML/KYC, market conduct, prudential requirements) across at least the majority of your assigned jurisdictions

  • Written legal proficiency in the primary language(s) of your assigned jurisdictions: assessed at a level sufficient to review regulatory source documents and AI-generated answers without the use of translation tools

  • Working proficiency in English required for all roles (programme coordination, briefings, and scoring guidance are in English)

Interested?

If you are passionate about leveraging technology to transform regulatory compliance and meet the qualifications outlined above, we invite you to apply. Please submit your resume detailing your relevant experience and interest in CUBE.​

CUBE is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Someone who plays games seriously, but understands that at least a bit of silliness is needed for success. Someone who thinks about all the edge cases, but knows doing it alone, will always leave blind spots. If you feel you have great ability, a growth mindset, and high ambition, then join us at the start of our journey!

  • UX flow design for entire game experience

  • Creation and implementation of UI screens, assets and animations

  • Involved in pioneering a modern workflow and optimise assets for performance

  • Proven ability to translate game design requirements into intuitive and visually stunning UI solutions

  • Experience collaborating closely with engineers, game designers and artists

  • Passionate about both UI & UX design

  • Range of 2D Art skills (UI elements, illustrations, animations, etc.)

  • Proficient understanding of Graphic Design and Typography

  • A self-starter approach to use AI: you've found ways to use it in your day-to-day work, you experiment, figure things out and bring the same energy to every new challenge.

Would Be Nice if You Also Have

  • At the forefront with AI tools and actively experimenting

  • Enjoys TCGs

Where You'll Be

This opportunity is based in our London office, and because we value a collaborative work environment and genuine human interactions, it is mostly an office‑based role.

Supercell New Games

This is a dedicated environment for building from zero and shaped around a core belief: the best developers don’t need more direction, they need more freedom and fewer barriers. This is where games get the space they need to become cultural phenomenons.

Players are waiting for your vision and ambition to build the next forever game a.k.a. the best work of your career. We back this up with creative and operational autonomy, and the infrastructure, capital, and experience needed to take a game from an idea to global scale.

This is not for everyone. Building towards a billion-dollar game is going to be hard. But let's not kid ourselves: it should also be fun.

You build the rocket. We bring the launchpad.

Game-changing Financial Model

Supercell is great with stuff around benefits and wellbeing, but most importantly you get to focus on what matters: making games. Skip the Venture Capital pitch decks and looking at runway spreadsheets. In exchange, we're offering a compensation model that makes this opportunity financially life-changing.

About Supercell

Supercell is a games company from Helsinki, Finland, with offices also in San Francisco, Seoul, Shanghai, and London. You might know us as the makers of Hay Day, Clash of Clans, Boom Beach, Clash Royale, and Brawl Stars. Our mission is to create great games that as many people as possible play for years and that are remembered forever.

So, how do we make great games? By putting together the best teams and giving them the freedom and independence to succeed. And by taking risks, failing, sharing learnings, and killing lots of projects.

Wishing you all the best,
The Supercell Recruitment team

Mission

Neko Health is a health technology company that opened its first clinic in Stockholm in 2018, founded by Daniel Ek and Hjalmar Nilsonne.

In one hour, our scan combines radiation-free imaging, heart and circulation measurements, and same-visit blood results with time to talk it through with a clinician, so people can act on what matters before symptoms appear. We design and build our own hardware, software and clinical protocols, and more than 100,000 members have already had a scan, with 75% booking and prepaying their next one before they leave.

As a team, we chase 10X, not 10%, and we’re looking for people who think the same way to help us scale what we’ve started in Sweden, the UK, and now the US. Join the clinicians, engineers and business builders making prevention a routine part of care.

Role Purpose

Neko is scaling fast. Our clinical teams already outnumber HQ across the US and Europe, and that ratio will keep growing. They deliver Neko’s promise to every member, every day – and right now, the information supporting their work is fragmented, inconsistent, and ungoverned. At our current pace, that's not just operational noise. It's a quality and safety risk. The role exists to fix that.

The role sits at the centre of two funnels. Inbound: you'll work closely with every team at Neko to shape what reaches clinical staff, when, and how. That means building trusted relationships across the organisation, helping teams understand what clinical staff need, and together making deliberate decisions about what gets communicated, what waits, and what can be consolidated. Outbound: once aligned and prioritised, you translate that into structured, cadenced formats that a dispersed clinical workforce can act on – right channel, right format, right frequency.

This is change management as much as communications. You're not just sending updates. You're redesigning how the whole organisation relates to its clinical teams.

 

What you'll deliver in the first 6-12 months

Build and enforce the intake model

  • Design the process that governs how every team at Neko communicates with clinical staff – how requests are submitted, evaluated, sequenced, and approved

  • Build the centralised view that ensures nothing reaches clinical staff in an uncoordinated or duplicative way

  • Document decision criteria clearly enough that stakeholders understand and trust how calls are made

  • Define escalation paths for urgent communications that need to move faster than the standard cadence

 

Drive organisation-wide change management

  • Partner with senior leadership to establish the intake model as an endorsed, org-wide norm – not an optional service, but the way Neko works

  • Run a structured roll-out across every team with touch points to clinical staff

  • Build the relationships that make the process feel collaborative rather than bureaucratic

  • Report regularly on intake volume, team compliance, and where we need to evolve.

 

Operationalise clinical communications

  • Start with a clear-eyed audit of how information reaches clinical teams today – the gaps, the overlaps, the friction

  • Build a global clinical programme with a single source of truth that clinical staff can rely on

  • Design the right mix of channels and formats for a dispersed, non-desk workforce – including AI-enabled formats like short-form video, audio briefings, and visual summaries

  • Create repeatable templates that make consistency straightforward for programme managers and local teams

  • Equip clinic leads with the tools and confidence to communicate well within their teams without losing global coherence

  • Define the metrics that prove it's working – comprehension, consistency, engagement, reduction in operational noise – and report on them regularly

  • Build a global communications cadence that helps leadership teams understand what’s changing, what’s ahead and how to prepare.

 

Minimum Qualifications

  • Proven experience in change management, or programme management, with direct ownership of communication or enablement strategy at scale

  • Proven experience designing and enforcing intake or governance processes across multiple cross-functional teams – you've built the model, sold it in, and made it stick

  • A track record running structured communications programmes for large, dispersed frontline workforces

  • Strong programme management instincts: you bring structure to ambiguity and build systems that hold

  • A creative communicator who knows when a policy document is right and when a 60-second video does the job better

  • Genuine fluency with AI tools and an appetite to use them to improve quality, efficiency, and reach

  • Sharp stakeholder skills: you can align leadership and cross-functional teams, hold the line when needed, and build trust in the process

  • Experience in high-growth, multi-site consumer services or healthcare strongly preferred

  • Comfortable working across multiple geographies and time zones

  • Strong written and verbal English; additional European languages a plus

About titles at Neko

We use a simplified internal title framework that prioritises clarity over hierarchy, so the title on this posting may differ from your internal title. We’ll be open about the scope and level of the role throughout the process, so you know exactly what you’d be taking on.

Atolls is the world's largest community-driven shopping platform, active in 20+ markets. 

We help millions make smarter spending decisions across discovery, evaluation, and (re-)purchase by connecting people with the right brands and retailers.

Our 1,000+ team across 10 countries builds products used every day at global scale, where you'll have real ownership and see your impact. Want to shape the destinations people rely on to shop with confidence? Keep reading.

About This Role:

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Product team in London or Munich with a hybrid work setup. In this role, you will take end-to-end ownership of our Gift Cards vertical; one of the fastest-growing parts of our alternative offers, spanning provider integrations, checkout and redemption flows, and multi-market expansion across France, Germany, and Spain.

You will lead commercial relationships with key gift card providers, define the product roadmap, and partner with engineering and design to scale gift cards into an integrated core offering across web, app, and browser extensions.

Our Benefits:

At Atolls, we believe in nurturing both your professional and personal growth. Here's what you can expect:

  • A culture that values personal and professional development, with internal mobility opportunities.
  • A supportive and open-minded team that embraces diverse perspectives and innovative ideas.
  • 32 days of paid vacation plus your birthday off, giving you the time you need to recharge.
  • A flexible hybrid working scheme to balance work and life.
  • Access to a learning budget and internal training to help you grow in your role.
  • Mental health coaching to support your well-being.
  • Regular global and local get-togethers to celebrate successes and build connections.
  • The possibility of taking a sabbatical after three years with the company.
  • A cloud-based company setup, providing flexibility and collaboration opportunities no matter where you are.

*These are global benefits that apply to all employees, with additional local perks based on your location.

Responsibilities:

In this role, you will:

  • Own the gift card product strategy and roadmap - from provider selection and inventory quality to the end-to-end purchase, redemption, and admin experience.
  • Lead commercial and provider negotiations - framework agreements, commission structures, SLAs, and multi-entity contracting with gift card providers (e.g. Finperks, Tillo), in partnership with Operations, Legal and Finance.
  • Drive revenue growth across markets - set and deliver GMV and commission targets across France, Germany, and Spain, backed by rigorous transaction-level analysis.
  • Partner cross-functionally - work daily with engineering, design, data, CRM, and adjacent product teams to ship a coherent gift card experience across web, app, and browser extension.
  • Use data to lead, not just report - build and refine models (e.g. fraud-tier scoring), validate revenue and performance data with Finance, and identify the next highest-impact bet.
  • Represent the vertical at the leadership level - bring clear recommendations and trade-offs to cross-team and leadership forums, and help shape Alternative Offers' broader strategic direction.
  • Build for scale - help expand gift cards from a standalone catalogue page into a fully integrated offer type across the platform.

 Your Profile:

  • 5+ years in product management, including significant time owning a product or business line end-to-end at a tech company and/or a startup.
  • A strong entrepreneurial track record - you've built something from close to zero, made judgment calls with imperfect data, and taken ownership beyond your formal remit.
  • Commercial fluency - comfortable owning revenue targets, running vendor/partner negotiations, and thinking in margin, commission, and unit economics, not just features.
  • Strong analytical skills - fluent working with transaction and revenue data to make and defend decisions; comfortable partnering with data/finance teams on models like fraud scoring.
  • Proven cross-functional leadership - experience leading engineering, design, and data counterparts in a matrixed environment, without formal authority over them.
  • Excellent stakeholder management - able to influence and present confidently to senior/executive stakeholders.
  • Fluent English required

Our hiring process:

  1. TA Call: Meet one of our Talent Experts and get to know Atolls better.
  2. Technical Round: Focus on the technical aspects of the role (Through a Live Case), and meet your potential manager.
  3. Final Round: Meet other Atollians 🏝️
    It varies from 1 to 3 interviews

*Some processes might slightly change according to needs

Ready to apply?

Be part of a destination where your work helps millions of people make better decisions every day. One focused application is all we need. If you truly fit more than one role, you're welcome to apply to up to three. This helps us match you with the right opportunity faster.

We review every application with equal care and will reach out if your profile aligns. Apply now with your CV in English.
*Portfolios, writing samples, or certifications may be requested based on the role.

#LI-PM1

#LI-Hybrid

At Atolls, we want to ensure that all employees can thrive in an inclusive environment. Our employment opportunities are open to every gender, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, ability, place of origin, or socioeconomic status. We remain committed to a culture of diversity, equity and belonging, where all employees are welcomed, respected, connected, and engaged. 

As part of our recruitment process at Atolls, we use AI tools for interview recording and transcription. These tools are designed to assist our teams and are never used independently to make hiring decisions. Every assessment and hiring decision is made by our hiring panel and team through human judgment.
Before your first interview, you will receive an email with the option to opt out. You can also change your preference at any time during the recruitment process by using the link in that email or by contacting your Talent Acquisition Partner.

The use of AI, or the choice not to use it, will not affect your application in any way.

data.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

The Senior Security Engineer – Enterprise Security shares ownership of the day-to-day operation of the Samsara security environment. You will keep our network access, device trust, and visibility systems running, tuned, and resilient at enterprise scale in partnership with a global team. Utilizing modern principles, you'll maintain and evolve a modern zero trust program, spend time both on policy design and real-time triage for escalations.

You take security seriously and believe the best solutions are low-friction and built in partnership with others. You are comfortable owning and maintaining production systems for long term success - troubleshooting systemic issues, tuning policies based on real incidents, and continuously improving what is already built. You bring an automation mindset to repetitive work, whether using Python, SOAR platforms, or AI-assisted tools. You enjoy supporting teammates and helping other engineers build their security knowledge.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the United Kingdom. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

About this team:

Enterprise Security is a global team spanning the US, EMEA, and India. We work in close partnership with our coworkers as collaborators rather than gatekeepers. Leadership is hands-on and technical, and our culture encourages everyone to contribute across the full stack.

Executive leadership actively champions security as a competitive advantage that builds customer trust and helps win enterprise partnerships. You will see a direct line between the zero trust systems you operate and the security that protects our physical operations partners worldwide. Our on-call rotation for the highest severity incidents is spread evenly across the team for one week out of every ten.

In this role, you will: 

  • Co-own the day-to-day operation, triage, and tuning of the Samsara endpoint security environment by responding to escalations, investigating anomalies, and resolving issues
  • Continuously improve existing endpoint visibility tools and workflows in partnership with our Security Operations team, and based on real usage patterns and incident learnings
  • Write clear, concise documentation and runbooks for enterprise security workflows
  • Collaborate with partners across Engineering, IT, and Security to ensure proper implementation of security tools and policies
  • Assist the Security Operations team during security investigations, acting as a technical subject matter expert within your domain
  • Partner with engineering teams to triage and support remediation of vulnerabilities and misconfigurations
  • Mentor engineers on the Security team to grow their domain knowledge, tool-specific skills, and communication abilities
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team)

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in an Enterprise Security role with demonstrated impact
  • Hands-on experience operating and maintaining endpoint security and visibility tools at enterprise scale (e.g. Crowdstrike, osquery, or similar)
  • Exposure to at least one additional enterprise security tool stack beyond endpoint security, such as Secure Access Service Edge (SASE), zero trust systems,  email security, Data Loss Prevention (DLP), or Identity and Access Management (IAM)
  • An automation mindset with experience scripting and debugging code with Python (with or without AIassistance) and using SOAR platforms
  • Strong familiarity with common security challenges and the ability to independently evaluate their severity and business impact
  • Track record of delivering impactful work across multiple quarters and collaborating effectively across teams

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Significant breadth across the endpoint security ecosystem, including designing layered controls with EDR tools, passive telemetry, integration with threat intelligence feeds, and operation in cloud and containerized environments.
  • History of building out security programs using modern SaaS security platforms such as Crowdstrike, Mimecast Incydr, and Splunk
  • Experience with infrastructure as code deployments using Terraform
  • Experience with AI-driven automations

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co.

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions

About the role

We are looking for a Regulatory Counsel to join our Legal team to oversee global regulations governing physical AI and ensure comprehensive compliance across our growing product lines. You will serve as a regulatory advisor to many cross-functional teams, managing regulatory reporting and mitigating compliance risks in the rapidly evolving physical AI landscape.

 

At Applied Intuition, you will:

  • Analyze, interpret, and advise on global laws and regulations that affect physical AI and intelligent vehicles, including automated driving and ADAS rules (NHTSA, FMVSS, state AV frameworks, UNECE regulations, EU type approval), vehicle software and cybersecurity standards (UN R155/R156, ISO 21434, ISO 26262, SOTIF), AI governance laws (EU AI Act, US state AI laws), privacy and data access regimes, and related defense and export control requirements

  • Serve as a regulatory advisor to product, engineering, sales, and cross-functional teams, translating requirements into practical guidance and into the toolchain, Vehicle OS, and software development lifecycle

  • Draft and review comments on proposed regulations, written feedback on proposed legislation, responses to agency requests for information, and trade association submissions

  • Scope regulatory requirements for prospective partnerships, customer programs, and new markets, and support deal teams on regulatory terms in commercial agreements

  • Own regulatory reporting and agency filings, and build the internal processes and controls that keep them accurate and on time

  • Support responses to regulatory inquiries, audits, and information requests, in coordination with Public Policy, Security, Privacy, and outside counsel

  • A J.D. from an accredited law school and active membership in good standing

  • 4 to 8 years of regulatory experience in-house, at a law firm, in government, or at a trade association, with substantive depth in administrative law, agency rulemaking, and compliance

  • Hands-on experience analyzing and drafting comments on proposed regulations or legislation

  • Experience advising on at least one of: vehicle safety regulation, autonomous vehicle or ADAS regulation, or export controls and defense compliance

  • The ability to explain complex legal requirements clearly to engineers, product managers, salespeople, and policy professionals, and to write memos and submissions that a regulator or legislator would find persuasive

  • Sound judgment in ambiguous situations, a practical and solutions-oriented approach, and the organization to run several matters at once under deadline

Nice to have:

  • Prior in-house experience at an autonomous vehicle (AV), OEM, or Tier 1 automotive supplier

Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

The Role

Checkout.com is looking for a proactive, analytical Senior Associate, Network Fee Management to join our global NFM team. In this role, you’ll help optimise network fees across the region by analysing card scheme economics, fee structures, and scheme updates - ensuring billing accuracy, optimising revenue assurance, and unlocking cost savings. Partnering directly with Sales and Account Management, you’ll deliver client facing insights to help win and retain key merchant business.

Based in London as the regional expert, you’ll collaborate across Commercial, Product, Finance, and Operations. You’ll own defined analyses and work streams from investigation through implementation - evaluating scheme impacts, coordinating change delivery, and enhancing internal controls. By turning complex fee data into practical financial models and actionable recommendations, you’ll directly guide commercial strategy, pricing decisions, and merchant discussions through strong project ownership and stakeholder influence.

How You'll Make an Impact

  • Network Fee Analysis & Reconciliation: Analyse network and scheme fee data across data sources and scheme insights. Investigate variances, identify root causes, and document findings with clear supporting evidence.

  • Fee Change Delivery: Assess the impact of scheme fee changes and coordinate with Finance, Commercial, Product, and Operations colleagues to support accurate implementation, configuration, and reporting.

  • Revenue Assurance & Cost Optimisation: Identify fee leakage, billing discrepancies, and opportunities to reduce costs through detailed analysis and ongoing monitoring. Recommend practical actions that protect revenue and improve fee accuracy.

  • Controls, Governance & Process Improvement: Maintain clear controls, documentation, and repeatable processes for fee analysis, reconciliations, and change management, helping the team work accurately and efficiently across markets.

  • Tools, Data & Insight: Utilising AI, this role will be expected to work on projects that improve reporting, analytical tools, and automation.

What We're Looking For

  • Payments Expertise: 5+ years of commercial experience in the payments industry within a fast-paced B2B environment, must have a strong understanding of payment network fee structures (Interchange, Scheme Fees, etc.) in particular Visa and Mastercard.

  • Operational Excellence & Commercial Impact: exceptionally organised and proactive operator who looks to drive continuous improvement, strengthens revenue assurance, and identifies opportunities to optimise costs.

  • Cost Model Delivery: Direct experience successfully designing, drafting, and launching complex global Cost models and structural frameworks, to aid the business in strategic design making.

  • Exceptional Communication: Ability to clearly communicate complex scheme related updates, and regulatory standards to stakeholders at all levels within the business and externally.

  • Ambiguity & Drive: Takes ownership of complex, evolving scheme-fee challenges - reconciling data and turning fee changes into clear, practical guidance for merchants and internal teams.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

About CuspAI

CuspAI is the frontier AI company on a mission to solve the breakthrough materials needed to power human progress. While nature took billions of years to perfect molecules, we are harnessing AI to unlock trillion-dollar materials breakthroughs in months, not millennia. Our founding team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering.

We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock.

We invite you to be part of a diverse, innovative team at the intersection of AI and materials science, working to create impactful partnerships that drive innovation, scalability, and industry collaboration. This work matters. Your work matters.

We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us.

The Role

Due to growth, we are seeking an experienced Events Lead to take complete ownership of our events programme and build CuspAI's events function from the ground up.

Your Impact

In this role you will be building the global events engine that accelerates CuspAI and the AI Materials Foundry, which is critical for driving real-world impact of our work across international markets.

Your main focus initially will be executing our flagship in-person Foundry event and subsequent international roadshows across Asia and Europe. Over time you will build out a repeatable event model, assemble an agile agency and vendor network, and establish CuspAI’s experiential presence across global scientific and machine learning conferences. As the team scales, the function will also own internal events.

What You Will Do

Foundry Events & Global Roadshows

  • Own our flagship in-person Foundry event end to end, establishing the core gathering for our global partner network.

  • With Partnerships, design, plan and deliver a regional roadshow of Foundry events across Asia, Europe and North America, creating a repeatable model for international expansion.

  • Run a regular cadence of virtual events to keep the global Foundry ecosystem engaged between in-person moments.

Partner, Customer & Conference Presence

  • With Comms/Marketing and Partnerships, design high-touch events for industrial partners and enterprise customers (e.g. executive dinners, virtual showcases, roundtables) aligned to commercial and ecosystem goals.

  • Own CuspAI’s presence at major conferences (e.g. NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, materials science summits): evaluate sponsorships, oversee booth and recruitment stand design, manage on-site logistics, and report on ROI.

  • Partner with Operations to deliver internal moments such as CuspCon, offsites and all-hands.

Interdisciplinary Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Communications, Product Marketing and Creative to bring CuspAI’s brand identity into physical spaces.

  • Work with Partnerships, Comms/Marketing and Operations to align every event with commercial, ecosystem and company goals.

  • Source and direct external agencies, AV suppliers and local vendors, and own budgets, timelines and post-event reporting to leadership.

Must Have Skills and Qualifications:

  • You are someone who gets excited about enabling world-class scientists and industry partners to collaborate on global sustainability and materials challenges.

  • 5+ years of experience in event management, experiential marketing, or event operations within a high-growth tech, deep-tech, or B2B environment.

  • Track record of delivering high-touch physical and virtual events internationally across EMEA and APAC regions.

  • Strong vendor management experience, with a history of sourcing, negotiating with, and directing production agencies, AV teams, and freelance staff.

  • Proven ability to balance strategic planning (e.g. budget management, roadmap design, ROI measurement) with hands-on, on-site event execution.

  • Excellent cross-functional stakeholder skills, with experience collaborating directly with executive leadership, sales, partnerships, and creative teams.

  • Flexibility to undertake regular UK and international travel for events, conferences, and site visits.

Bonus Points (But Not Critical):

  • Prior experience in a startup or scale-up environment building an event function or operational processes from scratch.

  • Direct experience engaging scientific, research-led, or highly technical audiences.

  • Familiarity with event management software, virtual event tools, and CRM systems (e.g. HubSpot, event platforms).

  • An eye for spatial design, environmental branding, or experiential production.

Additional Considerations

This role could be based in our Cambridge, London, Amsterdam or Berlin offices, with the expectation of being in the office three days per week. Additionally, there may be regular travel required to other locations for collaboration and project work.

What We Offer

  • A competitive salary: We value and reward impact and growth

  • Equity in CuspAI: You have a stake in the success of the company

  • Time off to stay fresh: 28 days holiday (DE, NL, UK) or 21 days holiday (JP, SG, US), in addition to local public holidays

  • ‘Gold Standard’ parental leave: 26 weeks (primary caregiver) and 12 weeks (secondary caregiver) at full pay - we look after you and your family while we work on the most important materials discovery problems together

  • Professional development budget: We invest in your career development so you can stay up to date with the latest industry knowledge or add to your skills to increase impact and growth

  • Solve meaningful problems: See how your work has a direct impact on advancing materials science and solving sustainability and climate-related problems through the creation and application of bleeding-edge SOTA technology and revolutionary techniques

  • True interdisciplinary teamwork: Be part of a deeply collaborative environment bridging AI research, computational chemistry, and experimental science - work with world-class researchers and engineers who enjoy sharing knowledge and supporting each other


Join us in shaping the future of materials with AI. Together, we can create groundbreaking solutions for a more sustainable world.


CuspAI is an equal opportunities employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We do not discriminate on the basis of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), veteran status, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

We actively encourage applications from all backgrounds and value the unique perspectives and contributions that diversity brings to our team.

Please let us know if you require any specific adjustments during or after the interview process. We will do everything we can within reason to accommodate.

Pipeline generation, partner deal registration, and closed ARR.

Making preventive health the default for every human in Europe

 

The mission

At Lucis, we believe healthcare should be preventive, not reactive. We’re building the OS for human longevity to help people add more healthy years to their lives. You can read more about who we are and how we work here.

 

The role

Health is complex, personal, and deeply important to our members. As the voice of Lucis clients, you support them throughout their health journey and own member happiness end to end.

With rapid member growth, we are hiring our first dedicated Customer Care Team Specialist. You will own the member experience end-to-end, stabilize our operational metrics, and build and manage a world-class support team.

What you will own

  • Member support: Resolve member and lab partner inquiries via chat, email and phone, with warmth, precision and a sense of urgency.

  • Phone-first when it matters: Pick up the phone whenever a situation calls for a human voice: a delayed result, a stressful moment, a confused member.

  • Know your boundaries: Work hand in hand with our medical team and know exactly when to escalate a health question rather than answer it yourself.

  • Voice of the member: Spot recurring issues and turn them into clear, structured feedback for the product and ops teams.

  • Contribute to projects: Take part in initiatives that improve the member experience, like rebuilding our Help Center, designing proactive care for lab delays, or automating repetitive workflows with AI.

 

About you

You’re passionate about the future of human health and want your work to help people stay healthy for longer. You move quickly from idea to execution, take full ownership of what you build, and work best with talented people who care as much as you do.

You thrive in fast‑moving environments, learn by doing, and value feedback as a way to continuously improve. You use AI the way others use a calculator: naturally, to go faster and think bigger.

 

You’ll fit in well if

  • Experience: 1+ years in B2C customer care, support, hospitality, or any role where you dealt directly with customers. Strong recent graduates with relevant experience are welcome too.

  • Bilingual: Fluent in both English and French, written and spoken.

  • People-first energy: You bring genuine warmth and empathy to every interaction, and you turn routine support into memorable experiences.

  • Rigorous precision: Exceptional attention to detail, with zero tolerance for misquotes, wrong information or operational errors. In health, accuracy is care.

  • Builder mindset: When something breaks twice, your instinct is to fix the root cause, not just the ticket.

Nice to have

  • Support tooling: You've used Intercom or similar support tools.

  • AI automation: You've already used AI tools to automate part of your work.

  • Startup mindset: You thrive in early-stage environments with high autonomy, rapid execution and clear communication.

 

The process

  • Intro call, culture & role fit (20 min)

  • Case study interview (30-60 min)

  • Deep dive and team chat, on-site (2 hours)

  • Reference calls

How we work

We work together from our Paris hub. We’re passionate about what we’re building and believe the fastest way to create something exceptional is side by side. We’re open to relocation support for the right individuals, and we welcome missionaries who travel to work with us in Paris on a regular basis.

  • Rigor without ego: Audits, science, and code all deserve the same high bar.

  • Radical ownership: Feedback loops are short; everyone contributes to building the best version of Lucis.

  • Velocity over perfection: We ship daily and prefer a good decision today over a perfect one next week.

About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

Role Summary

We are seeking an Applied AI, Forward Deployed Engineer to build customer use cases on top of the Mistral stack for our defense, government and critical-infrastructure customers. You will turn "we have agents" into "we shipped something a client uses." This role is about composing cybersecurity-related agentic workflows focused on cyberdefense, configuring harnesses for real-world scenarios, and delivering value directly to clients — often in sovereign, on-premises or classified environments.

You will work with some of the most security-sensitive organizations in the world: government agencies, sovereign institutions and operators of critical infrastructure. They need AI that is powerful, controllable and deployable on their terms.

Why this role:

you will build some of the first AI-for-cyberdefense systems deployed in real government and defense environments, on frontier models you can influence. You will work in a tight-knit team alongside elite experts in DFIR and cyberdefense — people who are passionate about their craft — and the patterns you implement at customer sites feed directly back into Mistral's internal use cases and products. Few roles put this much frontier technology this close to missions that matter.

What You Will Do

Client-Facing Agentic Solutions

  • You'll individually help deploy into production use cases with considerable business impact, with defense and government cybersecurity assignments as a priority

  • You'll work on state-of-the-art GenAI applications, driving a crucial technological transformation together with our customers

  • Tackle iconic customer use cases that no existing solution on the market can address — from custom configuration of cybersecurity harnesses for cloud defense, to agentic alert triage and investigation, incident response automation, detection engineering, threat intelligence analysis, and security log analysis at scale

  • You'll be involved in pre-sales calls to understand potential customers' needs, challenges, and aspirations, providing technical guidance on our products and explaining Mistral technologies to various stakeholders

  • You'll collaborate with our product and science teams to continuously improve our product and model capabilities based on customer feedback

  • Ship secure by design. Apply least-privilege access, secrets management, authN/authZ best practices, audit logging, human-in-the-loop approval for high-impact actions, and defenses against prompt injection and data exfiltration in agentic systems

  • Design and run evaluations that measure technical correctness, operational value and safety, so customers can trust what is being deployed

  • Own deployment end to end — observability, reliability, cost and latency tuning — including on-premises and air-gapped setups where customers require them

Our Principles

  • We care about people and outputs

  • What matters is what you ship, not the time you spend on it

  • Bureaucracy is where urgency goes to vanish. You talk to whoever you need to talk to. The best idea wins, whether it comes from a principal engineer or someone in their first week

  • We say what we mean. Feedback is direct, timely, and given because we care

  • Always ask why. The best solutions come from deep understanding, not from copying what worked before

  • No politics. Low ego, high standards

  • We embrace an unstructured environment and find joy in it

Security & Compliance criteria

  • Eligibility: must hold citizenship in the target territory (France for now).

  • Clearable: must meet all local requirements for high-level security clearance

About You

  • You are fluent in French, with strong English — this customer set works in French

  • You have 5+ years building systems in a cybersecurity context — SOC automation, DFIR automation, detection engineering, security tooling, or similar — with a record of operating what you ship in production

  • On top of that, you have 1+ year of hands-on experience building agentic or LLM-based systems, ideally in production — with a deep understanding of the concepts: prompting and context engineering, RAG, tool use, agentic orchestration, evaluations, guardrails, and knowing when to use each. If you don't have the production year yet, deep familiarity and the drive to learn fast in real, constrained environments is what we're looking for

  • You have strong technical coding skills in Python, plus full-stack experience: APIs, back-end services and front-end interfaces (e.g. TypeScript/React)

  • You have strong communication skills, with an ability to explain complex technical concepts in simple terms to both technical and non-technical audiences

Ideally, you have:

  • Experience with security tooling or workflows (SIEM, SOAR, EDR/XDR, threat intel)

  • Experience as a Security Operations Engineer, Detection & Response Engineer, or Incident Response Engineer

  • Experience as a Forward Deployed Engineer, Solutions Architect, Solutions Engineer

  • Prior work with government, defense, or national-security customers

  • A bias toward action and delivery — you ship fast, operate independently with a customer-led mindset, and reuse internal building blocks effectively

  • Strong problem-solving abilities, attention to detail, and a collaborative attitude

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

About Alta Ares


Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.

Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.

Role & Mission

As Strategy Analyst, you will work directly alongside Alta Ares' Director of Strategy to support the company's most important strategic decisions from market positioning and competitive intelligence to fundraising preparation and institutional partnerships.

This is a high-exposure, high-output role. You will produce the analyses, frameworks, and documents that land on the CEO's desk and in front of investors and government partners. You will be expected to think rigorously, move fast, and communicate with clarity in a company where the stakes are real and the pace is unrelenting.

If you come from strategy consulting or a defence policy background and want to apply that rigour to one of Europe's most ambitious deeptech companies, this role is for you.

1. Strategic Analysis & Market Intelligence

  • Conduct in-depth analyses of defence markets, procurement trends, geopolitical dynamics, and competitive landscapes across Alta Ares' key geographies (Europe, US, UK, APAC)

  • Track and synthesise developments in defence policy, NATO priorities, EU defence funding mechanisms (EDF, EUDIS), and national defence budgets

  • Map competitive positioning across the global defence AI and autonomous systems ecosystem — Anduril, Palantir, Helsing, Shield AI, and emerging European players

  • Produce structured, actionable intelligence reports for the Director of Strategy and executive team

  • Monitor technology trends relevant to Alta Ares' product roadmap: AI/ML in defence, C-UAS, ISR, autonomous systems

2. Strategic Projects & Decision Support

  • Support the Director of Strategy on high-priority cross-functional projects: market entry analysis, partnership evaluation, product-market fit assessment, and build/buy/partner decisions

  • Build financial models, scenario analyses, and business cases to support strategic decisions

  • Prepare executive-level presentations and strategy documents for internal leadership, board meetings, and investor interactions

  • Conduct structured research and due diligence on potential partners, markets, and acquisition targets

  • Track OKRs and strategic initiative progress across the company on behalf of the Director of Strategy

3. Fundraising & Investor Support

  • Support the preparation of fundraising materials: investor decks, data room content, market sizing analyses, and competitive benchmarks

  • Conduct research on potential investors, family offices, sovereign wealth funds, and defence-focused VCs

  • Prepare briefing notes ahead of investor meetings and track follow-up commitments

  • Assist in responding to investor due diligence requests with structured, well-sourced analysis

4. Institutional & Partnership Intelligence

  • Research and map key institutional stakeholders across NATO, EU, and bilateral defence frameworks relevant to Alta Ares' commercial and policy agenda

  • Support the preparation of partnership proposals, MoU frameworks, and institutional briefing documents

  • Monitor defence innovation programmes, grant opportunities, and government procurement initiatives that Alta Ares could engage with

  • Prepare country and market entry briefs for new geographies under consideration

5. Internal Strategy Communication

  • Draft and format internal strategy documents, memos, and decision briefs with clarity and precision

  • Support the Director of Strategy in preparing All-Hands presentations, leadership offsites, and quarterly strategy reviews

  • Maintain organised knowledge bases and strategic reference documents in Notion

Candidate Profile

Experience

  • 2 to 4 years of experience in strategy consulting, investment banking, corporate strategy, defence policy, or a related analytical role

  • Top-tier educational background: grande école (Sciences Po, HEC, Polytechnique, INSEAD) or equivalent international institution

  • Prior exposure to defence, aerospace, deep tech, or government-adjacent sectors is a strong plus

  • Experience producing executive-level deliverables under time pressure in a demanding environment

Skills & Qualities

  • Exceptional analytical rigour: you structure complex problems, identify the right frameworks, and reach clear conclusions

  • Outstanding written communication in English is mandatory: your memos, slides, and reports must be publication-ready

  • French fluency is mandatory: internal working language in Paris is French

  • Strong PowerPoint / Google Slides skills: you produce slides that are clear, well-structured, and visually sharp

  • Comfortable with financial modelling and quantitative analysis (Excel / Google Sheets)

  • Expert with Notion. Coding is a plus.

  • Fast learner: you get up to speed on new markets, technologies, and geopolitical contexts quickly and independently

  • Proactive and autonomous you don't wait to be told what to analyse next

  • Discreet and professional you will handle sensitive commercial, financial, and strategic information daily

    • Own the full end-to-end sales cycle from first contact to signed contract.

    • Manage complex, multi-stakeholder deals involving IT, Security, Operations, Compliance, HR, and C-level decision-makers.

    • Lead commercial negotiations and work with management to structure commercially sound agreements.

    • Maintain accurate CRM hygiene and provide reliable pipeline forecasting.

  • Market & Account Intelligence

    • Develop deep knowledge of the French market landscape, competitive dynamics, and regulatory environment (NIS2, KRITIS, DORA, and relevant French legislation).

    • Identify whitespace opportunities within existing accounts and coordinate with Customer Success for expansion.

    • Represent PRIMION at French industry events, trade fairs, and sector-specific forums.

  • Cross-functional Collaboration

    • Work closely with Pre-Sales, Product, Customer Success, and Marketing teams to ensure seamless customer experiences and aligned go-to-market execution.

    • Provide market feedback to help shape product roadmap priorities and localization requirements for the French market.


Key Qualifications

  • Must-Have

    • 5+ years of B2B sales experience, with at least 3 years in software or SaaS/enterprise technology solutions.

    • Strong hunter mentality with the drive to identify opportunities, build pipeline, and win new business.

    • Demonstrated success in closing complex, multi-stakeholder deals with 6-figure+ contract values.

    • Experience selling to enterprise accounts in at least one of PRIMION's target verticals (Critical Infrastructure, Healthcare, Logistics, Manufacturing, Public Sector, or Financial Services).

    • Strong consultative selling skills with the ability to translate technical capabilities into measurable business outcomes.

    • Comfortable navigating complex organizational structures and building relationships at C-level, VP, and Director level.

    • Native or fluent French speaker; professional English proficiency for internal collaboration.

    • Based in France with the ability and willingness to travel extensively across the territory, with a particular focus on Southern France.

  • Nice-to-Have

    • Experience with physical security, access control, video surveillance, or workforce management solutions.

    • Familiarity with NIS2, KRITIS, or similar European cybersecurity/compliance frameworks relevant to critical infrastructure operators.

    • Experience working with channel partners and system integrators as part of a go-to-market model.

    • Exposure to identity management, OT/IT security convergence, or PSIM platforms.

    • Formal sales methodology certification (MEDDIC, Challenger, SPIN Selling, or similar).

 

What We Offer

Protect what matters – Powered by People. At Primion, we lead with human responsibility and win through collaboration. Our aim is to build long-term relationships based on mutual respect and trust.

That's why we offer you:

  • Impact: Benefit from a high-impact, high-autonomy commercial role with significant territory ownership and the opportunity to directly influence PRIMION's growth across the French market.

  • Compensation: Enjoy a competitive base salary complemented by a capped, performance-based variable compensation structure that rewards success.

  • Stability: Benefit from the backing of an established European technology brand with a 30+ year track record, strong R&D investment, and a clear multi-year growth strategy.

  • Market Opportunity: Capitalize on growing market demand driven by regulatory developments such as NIS2 and KRITIS, creating strong opportunities for customer acquisition and business growth.

  • Collaboration: Work closely with Pre-Sales experts, Customer Success Managers, and Product specialists to develop compelling customer solutions and drive successful sales outcomes.

  • Excellence: Continuously develop your expertise through PRIMION's sales enablement resources, industry insights, and proven vertical playbooks.

  • Growth: Grow with a business that is actively expanding across European markets while taking on increasing responsibility and shaping future market success.

  • Equipment: Benefit from a company car as well as modern business equipment, including a company phone and laptop, to support your daily work and customer engagements.

Have we piqued your interest?

Then we look forward to receiving your application!

If you have any questions in advance, please call Amélie SEGAUD +33 6 74 84 85 81
