Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

 

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

 

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

 

En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

 
 

Pourquoi ce rôle est-il si important chez nous ?

 

En tant que Spécialiste Support Services Financiers, tu te positionnes comme un expert métier et plateforme.

 

Tu es l'interlocuteur privilégié de notre base clients qui a choisi Pennylane comme logiciel central de sa gestion comptable et financière.

 

Grâce à ta maîtrise de l’allemand et du français, tu accompagnes les clients et traites leurs demandes dans ces deux langues, notamment celles émanant d’Allemagne, en lien avec nos équipes internes. Tu contribues ainsi à leur offrir une expérience de support claire, réactive et adaptée à leurs besoins.

 

Tu te trouves donc au cœur de l'expérience client 360 et fais profiter les clients et leurs comptables de la pleine puissance de Pennylane au service de leur croissance.

 

Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ?

 

En tant que membre de l'équipe Support applicatif et technique, tu es le point de relais central entre nos clients Dirigeants, leurs Comptables internalisés et l'équipe Support. Tu es en contact quotidien avec les utilisateurs et cherches à comprendre les problèmes qu'ils rencontrent.

 

Après investigation, ton but est d'apporter une réponse ou une solution à ton interlocuteur ou, quand cela est nécessaire, d'escalader le problème aux équipes techniques.

 

Tu prends en charge les demandes des clients en allemand et en français, notamment celles émanant d’Allemagne, et transmets les éléments utiles aux équipes internes. Tu assures le suivi des demandes jusqu’à leur résolution et veilles à communiquer de manière claire à chaque étape.

 

Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ?

 

3 premiers mois :

 

  • Tu intègres la CSM Academy et tu te formes en continu sur le produit et les rouages de l'équipe.

  • Tu apprends tout ce qu'il faut savoir sur notre entreprise, notre vision, et nos différents départements.

  • Tu apprends à identifier toutes les parties prenantes et à collaborer efficacement au sein de ton équipe, ainsi qu'avec les différents départements.

  • Tu commences à répondre aux demandes des clients liées à nos services financiers : tu réceptionnes les demandes, les qualifies et apportes des réponses rapides et impactantes.

  • Tu te familiarises avec les besoins des clients, notamment en Allemagne, et commences à traiter leurs demandes en allemand et en français, avec l’appui de l’équipe.

 

4 à 6 mois :

 

  • Tu gagnes en autonomie et prends intégralement les commandes de ton portefeuille client.

  • Tu gères des demandes clients de plus en plus complexes, notamment celles émanant d’Allemagne : tu analyses la situation, identifies les informations nécessaires et recherches une solution adaptée.

  • Tu échanges avec les équipes internes en français, formalises les éléments utiles à l’investigation et assures le suivi des demandes escaladées.

  • Tu contribues à la création et à l’actualisation des supports d’aide à disposition des clients, notamment en allemand, afin de développer leur autonomie.

  • Tu partages à tes collègues tes connaissances comptables et ton expérience "terrain".

  • Tu portes la voix et les usages des clients, notamment ceux situés en Allemagne, et partages aux équipes produit des retours construits sur leurs besoins et les difficultés rencontrées.

 

Et ensuite... :

 

  • Tu deviens un expert produit et fais gagner en efficacité ton équipe en identifiant les axes d'amélioration

  • Tu prends le contrôle et mènes au succès des projets qui te tiennent à cœur et qui te font progresser

 

Profil recherché

 

  • Tu es bilingue allemand / français, à l’écrit comme à l’oral. Tu peux accompagner les clients et traiter leurs demandes dans les deux langues, et collaborer au quotidien en français avec les équipes internes.

  • Tu sais expliquer des sujets parfois techniques ou financiers de façon claire, faire preuve d’écoute et adapter ta communication à ton interlocuteur.

  • Tu es à l’aise pour investiguer une demande, en assurer le suivi et solliciter les bonnes équipes lorsque c’est nécessaire.

  • Expérience de plusieurs années au sein d’une “néo-banque”, d’une banque en ligne ou d’une banque traditionnelle.

  • Excellente compréhension du système bancaire.

  • Expérience précédente en support B2B requise.

  • À l’aise avec des échanges téléphoniques quotidiens avec les clients.

  • Un travail en direct avec le dirigeant est un plus (conseil interne par exemple).

  • Disponible pour des horaires roulants et adaptés aux besoins des clients.

  • Un intérêt pour la technologie est un plus avec notamment la connaissance des produits des Fintech actuelles du marché.

 

Poste ouvert au télétravail avec 2 jours de déplacements à Paris au sein de nos locaux par mois (frais pris en charge).

 
 

Process de recrutement

 

- Entretien en visio avec Simon Peraldo - Senior Recruiter (30 min)

- Entretien en visio avec Vincent Lambert - Responsable de l’équipe (1h)

- Dernier échange visio avec Nathan Robinet - Senior Team Lead Customer Support - Financial Services (45 min)

🎁 Ce que l’on peut t'offrir :

🏥 Une mutuelle parmi les meilleures sur le marché (Alan Blue et Alan Mind)

🍜 Des tickets restaurants (Carte Swile)

🏝 Entre 6 et 12 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés

🇬🇧 La possibilité de perfectionner ton anglais grâce à Busuu

🧑‍💻 Un budget dédié chaque mois pour tous nos Pennylaners, favorisant le travail depuis la maison ou en espace de coworking

🏢 Une facilité d’accès à nos bureaux, situés à quelques minutes de Saint Lazare en plein cœur de Paris

💵 Une enveloppe de BSPCE

🏃‍♀️ Un accès à 8000 salles de sport partout en France et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via notre partenaire Gymlib

💻 Un Mac

🎉 Nous pratiquons de nombreux sports ensemble et avons à cœur de nous réunir régulièrement autour d’événements d’entreprise tels que les Tech Days (qui permettent aux Pennylaners en remote de se réunir tous les 3 mois) ou notre séminaire d’entreprise qui a lieu une fois par an, et qui favorise de grands moments de cohésion pour toutes et tous.

 

Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra:

-Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)

-Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant

-Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes

-Avoir un recul suffisant pour prioriser les actions à fort impact business dans son activité quotidienne.

 

Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins susceptibles de postuler que d'autres si elles estiment ne pas remplir l'intégralité des critères.

Si tu hésites, nous t'encourageons à postuler quand même : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d'une collaboration significative et durable !

 

Information importante à destination des candidat(e)s

Les tentatives d’arnaque au recrutement sont en hausse. Nous vous invitons à rester vigilant(e) lors de vos échanges.

 

Candidature uniquement via nos canaux officiels : postulez exclusivement via nos offres publiées sur nos supports officiels (site carrière, pages officielles partenaires).

Vérifiez systématiquement l’adresse e-mail de l’expéditeur : nos communications sont envoyées depuis des adresses professionnelles avec les domaine @pennylane.com ou ----- .

Nous ne vous demanderons jamais de paiement, ni d’informations financières (coordonnées bancaires, paiement pour un entretien, achat de matériel, etc.) dans le cadre du recrutement.

Si une telle demande vous est faite, il s’agit d’une fraude. Nous vous invitons à ne pas répondre et à nous le signaler immédiatement."

 

Encourageant la diversité, équité et inclusion sous toutes ses formes, Pennylane offre un environnement de travail inclusif, bienveillant et propice à l’épanouissement, dans nos bureaux et en remote. Nous nous engageons à fournir les mêmes chances à tous nos candidats, indépendamment de leurs origines sociales et ethniques, genres, religions, orientations sexuelles ou handicaps.

🇫🇷 Données personnelles

Why This Role Exists

At Pennylane, our website plays a pivotal role in acquiring and converting customers, transforming traffic from paid acquisition, SEO, partnerships, and other channels into sign-ups, demo bookings, and product adoption.

 

As we accelerate our Financial Services offering, including pro account, and the monetization of our existing customer base, we are seeking a CRO Manager to own conversion across these strategic areas.

 

You will lead the production and optimization of website pages and paid landing pages, from identifying friction to measuring business impact.

 

You will join the Website team within Growth and collaborate closely with Growth Engineers and Data in a multidisciplinary squad.

 

🌍 About Pennylane

Pennylane is one of France’s leading fintech unicorns, building the financial and accounting operating system for European SMEs and accounting firms.

 

Founded in 2020, we help business owners make better decisions and empower accountants to focus on advising their clients.

 

Key Figures and Ambition

  • 💻 Over 1.3 million SMEs already work with Pennylane

  • 🤝 More than 7,000 accounting firms use our platform

  • 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Over 1,100 Pennylaners from more than 25 nationalities

  • 💰 More than €400 million raised since launch

  • 🌍 Remote-friendly, international culture expanding across Europe

 

What You’ll Do

You will own conversion across the Financial Services and Monetization scope, working across website pages, paid landing pages, product journeys, experimentation, and measurement.

 

Own CRO and Experimentation

  • Define and execute the conversion strategy for key journeys, including pro account landing pages, pricing and product pages, demo-booking journeys, self-sign-up, and upsell flows

  • Build and run a continuous A/B testing program, from ideation and scoping to sizing, analysis, and ship-or-kill decisions

  • Identify conversion friction and opportunities through analytics and behavioral insights

  • Develop clear hypotheses based on user behavior, business priorities, and funnel performance

  • Ensure experiments are measured against meaningful business outcomes

 

Manage the Website Conversion Roadmap

  • Own and prioritize the conversion roadmap for your scope based on expected impact and feasibility

  • Turn opportunities into actionable briefs, specifications, and delivery plans

  • Work closely with Growth Engineers, Data, Design, and other stakeholders to ship improvements

  • Coordinate QA, launch, and post-launch analysis

  • Own key Financial Services journeys, including pro account activation and the accountant portal

  • Contribute to monetization journeys such as upsell and self-sign-up

 

Build and Optimize Paid Landing Pages

  • Produce and optimize landing pages for Financial Services and Monetization campaigns

  • Help increase the speed and volume of landing-page delivery, removing the current bottleneck

  • Partner with Demand Generation and Paid/SEA teams to translate campaign objectives into high-performing pages

  • Develop a strong understanding of target audiences, market context, and local messaging

  • Use these insights to improve both paid landing pages and the wider website experience

 

Own Measurement and Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Define instrumentation and tracking plans with Data

  • Build and maintain dashboards to monitor conversion performance

  • Report on results, learnings, and next steps to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Work closely with Demand Gen, Product, Sales and Customer Success Operations, Brand, Design, and Engineering

  • Create alignment across teams and move projects forward without relying on formal authority

 

What You Bring

  • 3–5 years of experience in CRO, Conversion, Website Product Management, Growth, or a related field

  • Experience in B2B SaaS, fintech, digital products, or another data-driven environment

  • A track record of shipping initiatives end-to-end and demonstrating their impact on business metrics

  • Strong hands-on experience with analytics and CRO tools, such as Amplitude and Contentsquare

  • Ability to independently analyse data, identify patterns, and formulate relevant hypotheses

  • Solid understanding of A/B testing methodology, including experiment sizing, success metrics, statistical pitfalls, and decision-making

  • Experience managing a roadmap and prioritizing initiatives based on impact and feasibility

  • Strong project management skills, from writing a clear brief to coordinating delivery and measuring results

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to:

    • Write clear briefs for designers and engineers

    • Explain prioritization decisions to stakeholders

    • Present results and recommendations to non-technical audiences

  • Ability to build relationships and secure alignment across multiple teams

  • Fluent French and professional English

 

🛠️ Tools and Environment

You will work with tools and processes dedicated to experimentation, analytics, behavioral analysis, tracking, and landing-page production.

 

Some our Tools Include

  • Amplitude

  • AB Tasty

  • Analytics and reporting dashboards

  • Website content and landing-page production tools

 

You will collaborate closely with Growth Engineers, Data, Demand Generation, Product, Sales and Customer Success Operations, Brand, and Design.

 

What You Can Expect

  • Ownership of conversion across two strategic areas for Pennylane: Financial Services and Monetization

  • Direct and measurable impact on sign-ups, demo bookings, product activation, and upsell performance

  • The opportunity to shape the conversion roadmap across website and paid landing pages

  • A central role in structuring and scaling our experimentation program

  • Close collaboration with Growth Engineering, Data, Product, Demand Gen, Sales, Customer Success Operations, Brand, and Design

  • High level of autonomy and visibility across the organization

  • Challenging and supportive environment focused on ownership, execution, learning, and measurable impact

 

Success in This Role

Your success will be measured by:

 

  • The frequency and quality of experiments launched

  • The speed and volume of website and landing-page delivery

  • Conversion-rate improvement across the Financial Services and Monetization funnels

  • Growth in relevant outcomes, including sign-ups and demo bookings

  • Ability to absorb inbound landing-page demand without creating a delivery bottleneck

Permanent position based in Paris on a hybrid basis or fully remote anywhere in France.

data.description:
Ta mission

En tant qu’Account Executive / Account Manager Small Accounts, tu seras responsable du développement commercial d’un portefeuille de cabinets d’expertise comptable.

Ta priorité sera de développer l’acquisition de nouveaux cabinets, tout en augmentant progressivement la valeur des clients existants. Tu prendras en charge l’ensemble de la relation commerciale sur ton portefeuille régional : identification des opportunités, prospection, vente de Pennylane, accompagnement du déploiement et développement de revenus additionnels.

Tu seras responsable de ton portefeuille de bout en bout, en combinant acquisition et upsell afin de fluidifier l’expérience client, limiter les ruptures de suivi et maximiser la valeur générée dans la durée.

Tes responsabilités

  • Identifier et qualifier de nouveaux cabinets d’expertise comptable sur ton territoire.

  • Piloter l’ensemble du cycle de vente : prospection, découverte, qualification, démonstration, négociation, closing.

  • Comprendre les enjeux, le modèle économique et le portefeuille clients des cabinets.

  • Identifier les opportunités auprès des TPE/PME clientes des cabinets partenaires.

  • Développer les comptes existants via des opportunités d’upsell, de cross-sell et de plans payants.

  • Mener les échanges commerciaux liés à l’acquisition, au déploiement et à la monétisation.

  • Construire des plans de compte et prioriser tes actions selon le potentiel business et les besoins des clients.

  • Maintenir une donnée CRM fiable sur les différents funnels : acquisition, déploiement et monétisation.

  • Produire des forecasts fiables et mettre à jour régulièrement tes opportunités.

  • Collaborer avec les équipes Sales Operations, Marketing, Produit, Success et Onboarding.

  • Faire remonter les retours clients et contribuer à l’amélioration des process, playbooks et messages commerciaux.

  • Organiser et participer à des événements locaux, webinaires et actions commerciales.

  • Analyser tes performances et développer continuellement ton efficacité commerciale.

Les critères de réussite

  • Atteinte régulière des objectifs d’acquisition et de développement de portefeuille.

  • Pipeline sain, qualifié et correctement priorisé.

  • Forecast fiable et excellente hygiène CRM.

  • Qualité des phases de découverte et de qualification.

  • Conversion des opportunités de déploiement et de monétisation pertinentes.

  • Forte qualité de relation avec les cabinets.

  • Esprit d’équipe, d’entraide et de collaboration transverse forts.

  • Contribution active à l’apprentissage collectif de l’équipe.

Ton profil

  • Première expérience en vente B2B/Saas, account management ou développement commercial.

  • Capacité à gérer un cycle de vente structuré de la prospection au closing.

  • Goût du contact client et capacité à créer une relation de confiance.

  • Intérêt pour les environnements combinant chasse et développement de portefeuille.

  • Capacité à comprendre les enjeux business et à construire une proposition de valeur pertinente.

  • Sens de l’organisation, de la priorisation et de l’exécution.

  • Aisance avec les données, les outils CRM et les indicateurs commerciaux.

  • Capacité d’adaptation dans un environnement qui évolue

  • Goût du travail en équipe et de la collaboration transverse.

  • Une expérience dans le SaaS, la fintech, la comptabilité ou les logiciels de gestion est un plus.

  • Niveau d’anglais permettant d’avoir des échanges professionnels internes à l’entreprise

  • Disponibilité pour des déplacements ponctuels.

Processus de recrutement :

  • Un premier entretien avec un Business Recruiter (30 min)

  • Un échange avec Claudia (Sales Team Lead - Small Accounting Firms)

  • Un Case study avec Claudia et Valentin (Head of Sales Accounting Firms)

  • Un Team Fit

Our Vision & Products

🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship

One of the Top Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World

60 Million Users in 3 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next

At EverAI, we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 60 million users and counting, we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories.

Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform, redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first.

And we’re only just getting started!

Our Team

We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.

Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

• 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership

• Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO)

• Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23

Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO]

• 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM

• Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands)

Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]

• 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth

• Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue)

Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]

• 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A

• Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone)

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited)

• Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited)

Your Role

Most LLM roles stop at experimentation.

Here, the models you improve power experiences for 50M+ users.

Most of our traffic runs on self-hosted, fine-tuned open-weight models. On our internal roleplay evals, our smaller fine-tuned models can outperform much larger off-the-shelf models. Your job is to make them better.

You’ll join a small AI team led by Marco, our LLM Tech Lead, working closely with our CTO, Product, Web and DevOps teams. You’ll work across data, post-training, evals, and model behavior, taking ideas from failure analysis to production.

The problems are real: personalization, character consistency, long conversations, better evals, multilingual behavior, and faster training cycles.

If you want to shape model behavior at consumer scale, this is the role.

Key Responsibilities

  • Fine-tune open-weight LLMs using SFT, LoRA/QLoRA and post-training methods such as DPO and GRPO

  • Diagnose model failures and turn them into experiments. Decide whether the answer is better data, post-training, prompting or classifiers

  • Build training data and evals that directly shape what gets trained next

  • Improve model behavior across personalization, consistency, tone, multilingual and group interactions

  • Ship to production and use real user behavior to guide the next iteration

  • Speed up the training loop so experiments are faster, easier to compare, and more reproducible

Your Qualifications

  • You’ve personally post-trained open-weight LLMs for a user-facing product and shipped them to production

  • You’ve worked where AI was core to the product or business, not an experimental side feature

  • Fine-tuning is core to your experience

  • Strong Python, PyTorch and Hugging Face, with hands-on GPU training and debugging

  • You build data and evals yourself and make decisions from evidence

  • You can take work beyond notebooks into production

  • You use AI tools daily in your own engineering work

  • You are fully comfortable working with uncensored models and explicit NSFW content, including harmful material when developing and evaluating moderation system

Bonus points

  • Experience with conversational AI, roleplay products, or highly personalized consumer AI

  • Multilingual LLMs

  • Moderation, safety, or adversarial testing

  • Multimodal models

  • Open-source LLM / post-training contributions

Why EverAI?

📈 Exponential Growth: From 60M users in 3 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond

🚀 Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation: We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it

🌍 Global Impact: Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

🧠 Proven Leadership: A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

👥 Elite Remote Team: 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies, with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

🛡️ Ethical Core: Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology, ensuring responsible development at scale

What We Offer

✍️ Contract Type: We prefer B2B, but we’re flexible, what matters is long-term commitment and impact
📍 Work From Anywhere: Fully remote. Choose the environment where you do your best work
🏝️ Paid Time Off: 20 working days of PTO per year to recharge and reset
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Annual Gathering: A yearly in-person meetup to connect, brainstorm, and celebrate wins together
❤️‍🩹 Health & Wellness Support: Monthly allowance of 100 USD for health insurance expenses & access to unlimited 1:1 sessions with psychologists and lifestyle experts through OpenUp (also available to up to three of your family members)
🏢 Co-Working Space Budget: Work from a co-working space up to twice per month (35 EUR / 40 USD per visit) to stay inspired and connected
📚 Learning Budget: Dedicated funds to support your professional growth: courses, books, conferences, events, or certifications
💻 Company Laptop & Equipment: Laptop provided + monitor budget up to 250 USD + keyboard/mouse/mic/headphones budget up to 150 USD
⚡ AI Tools Access: Premium access to ChatGPT, Hugging Face, Claude Code, and any other tool needed to excel at your job, power your ideas and workflows

🎯 Top Tier Talent Is Our Multiplier

We’re a fully remote group of A-players from Tier 1 tech, led by an exec team who’ve launched, scaled, and exited multiple companies. We move fast, and care deeply about what we build — and who we build it with.

We’re looking for exceptional talent ready to ship & distribute world-first AI products at scale, fast, and co-create with us this category-defining business.

If that’s you — reach out and apply!

vos missions

As Project Quality Manager, you own the Project & Program pillar of Harmattan’s Quality organization. You set the quality standards that carry every programme from first prototypes through to mass production. You lead the Project Quality Engineers and act as the quality counterpart of Program Management, Engineering and our institutional customers. Your work keeps quality gates rigorous at the right level for each development phase, in line with ISO 9001 / EN 9100.

Leadership & Team Building

  • Lead, coach and grow the Project Quality Engineering team, and allocate engineers across active programmes.

A senior hardware engineer who has designed and shipped complex PCBs, ideally mixing digital and significant power (hundreds of watts), into production. They are rigorous on schematics, layout, and bring-up, and have a strong instinct for cost and manufacturability. They design with real-world operating conditions in mind - temperature, moisture, surges - and an interest in battery thermal management; direct experience of outdoor-deployed equipment is a plus rather than a prerequisite. They are comfortable working autonomously in a small team and can bridge hardware and firmware.

Skills required

  • PCB schematic and layout design (Altium Designer preferred)

  • Power electronics design: ~300 W DC/DC conversion, protection, derating, efficiency and thermal budgets

  • Thermal regulation: temperature sensing and control loops, battery storage temperature management, heatsinking

  • Mixed-signal design: power management, MCU interfaces, communication buses (SPI, I2C, UART, USB, CAN, Ethernet)

  • DFM/DFA for PCB manufacturing and assembly

About us

Founded in 2019 and part of Y Combinator’s Summer 2020 cohort, Photoroom is the leading AI photo and video solution for e-commerce, helping businesses sell at first sight.

Backed by Series B funding, we’ve reached 300M+ downloads and now process around 7 billion images a year for businesses of every size, from solo sellers to global brands and marketplaces like Amazon, Decathlon, and Depop. We serve them through our mobile app, web platform, and API, with tailored solutions for enterprise catalogs.

We’re an international team of 130+, with offices in Paris and New York. We take ownership of what we build, move quickly to learn what works, and speak candidly, united by our ambition to create exceptional impact for e-commerce businesses worldwide.

Role Summary

We're looking for a Product ML Engineer to join one of our product experience teams — SMB, Scaler or Enterprise — and own the ML side of short, high-impact projects.

You'll work on focused ML problems with a clear product outcome, sometimes fine-tuning one of our models, sometimes integrating the best externally available model, but always choosing the fastest and most effective path to customer value.

You'll bring the technical depth of an Applied Scientist while operating with the pace and pragmatism of a product engineer. You'll own the journey from framing the problem through to shipping, measuring and iterating on the feature in production.

Your time horizon is weeks rather than quarters, and success is measured by what reaches users and the impact it creates.

About the role

  • Embed directly within a product team. Work closely with the SMB, Scaler or Enterprise team on focused ML problems tied to clear customer and business outcomes.

  • Own ML projects end to end. Frame the problem, choose the approach, execute the plan, ship the feature and monitor its performance in production.

  • Make the build vs. buy decision. Determine when to fine-tune or build a model yourself versus integrating an external model, API or existing library.

  • Move from idea to production quickly. Work on projects scoped in weeks rather than quarters, prioritising rapid iteration and customer impact.

  • Work closely with the ML team. Leverage shared infrastructure, evaluation tooling and expertise while remaining embedded in the product team's priorities and cadence.

  • Stay close to users. Get rapid feedback from customers, monitor how people use what you've shipped and use those insights to drive the next iteration.

  • Balance technical depth with pragmatism. Know when deeper modelling work is necessary and when an existing solution is already good enough to ship.

  • Write production code. Work directly in the product team's codebase rather than operating primarily through research notebooks and experiments.

  • Own quality in production. Build sound evaluations, monitor performance and investigate failures once the feature is live.

About You

  • You've shipped ML into production. You have 2+ years of hands-on experience building and shipping ML-powered products, with strong experience in PyTorch or equivalent frameworks such as TensorFlow or JAX.

  • You have applied-science depth. You can fine-tune vision or diffusion models, design meaningful evaluations and debug training runs when necessary.

  • You're a pragmatic builder. You care about solving the customer's problem rather than proving that your own model is the best approach. You'll happily use an external model, API or existing library when that's the fastest route to value.

  • You're product-minded. You measure success through shipped features, user behaviour and business outcomes rather than papers or benchmarks alone.

  • You're comfortable in production codebases. You can move between experimentation and production engineering, writing maintainable code that lives inside a real product.

  • You have strong ownership. You're comfortable taking an ambiguous ML problem, deciding what matters, choosing an approach and driving it through to production.

  • You iterate quickly. You enjoy short feedback loops and would rather ship something useful, learn from users and improve it than spend months optimising something that hasn't reached production.

  • You're curious and collaborative. You can both explain your expertise and learn from the deep technical expertise around you. You value knowledge sharing and humility.

  • You're fluent in English. French isn't required.

Nice to have: experience shipping generative image models or diffusion models into production; experience evaluating third-party AI APIs against internal alternatives; experience working in a fast-growing startup or directly within a product team.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary + meaningful equity

  • Hybrid working from our Paris headquarters

  • Visa sponsorship and relocation support up to €10,000

  • MacBook Pro

  • Private healthcare

  • Regular company off-sites and team retreats

  • International English-speaking team

  • Language lessons in English and French

Hiring Process

  1. Screening with an ML Researcher / Engineer

  2. Home technical assignment and review with the team

  3. Culture fit interview and meet the team

data.description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

🤖 The Offer Area

We’re the engine that decides what Alan sells, at what price, and on what terms.

Every Alan member, from a 3-person startup to a public administration body with 200K+ collaborators is covered by an offer that our area designed, priced, contracted and renews every year.

We own the whole offer lifecycle for several kind of services (health insurance, life & disability insurance, employee benefits) across 4 countries. We manage an incredible business complexity and diversity in a scalable way, and most importantly, we empower others to act autonomously on it:

  • Offer creation: Enabling Sales to build compliant and relevant offers themselves in minutes, with a real-time pricer and AI assistance, without waiting days for an actuary.

  • Contract Lifecycle: Not only signing a contract in one go and writing the settings that become the source of truth for the rest of Alan, but also providing Business Ops with the tools they need to pilot over the years a portfolio of 100K+ contracts

  • Enabling growth: We’re at the root of Alan’s Insurance stack. Our technical decisions have a long reach: Claims, Billing and many other teams depends on us. We are key to lift blockers and enable the opening of new segments or markets.

🚀 What you'll build and who you'll work with

  • 🌍 One insurance stack for every country. We're replacing country-by-country code with a shared "Core Stack": one set of shared rules, with room for local differences. Spain already runs on it, and we’re now tackling France. The architecture decisions you make will shape how Alan sells insurance for the next 10 years. (How we made our offer builder global)

  • 🤖 AI-native underwriting. Insurance is complex, and most insurers need actuaries on every quote. We empower our Sales to build compliant and relevant offers themselves in minutes. AI-assisted smart alternatives, price explanations, pitching and more are already in the Sales hands, and there’s much more to build.

  • 🛡️ Life & Disability as a first-class product: We’re bringing this historically smaller product at Alan to the same level of maturity as Health, with first class member XP, Ops and enabling access to a much wider population.

  • 🧑‍🚀 A growing team. You'll hire it, shape it, and decide what it works on. Talent density, onboarding, feedback, and the mix of skills the area needs are yours to own.

  • 🛡️ Technical direction and operational excellence. Architecture calls, quality standards and shaping the organization and incident response as we scale to more countries. And you stay hands-on: at Alan, engineering leaders are expected to build.

⚡ Why this role is special

  • Dual impact: Shape both technical excellence and team growth, engineers become better while building better products

  • Leadership growth: Influence engineering culture, mentor future leaders, and drive technical strategy that shapes the future of healthcare delivery

  • Your users sit next to you: Hundred of Alaners use what your team ships every day. The feedback loop between building and impact is very short, which allows you to iterate and move quickly.

  • Complex domain, simple software: Regulated domain, many countries, many segments… The job is to model a messy real world into a stack that stays simple and easy to extend.

  • Direct business impact. We own pricing, contract lifecycle and Sales tooling. We have a direct impact on Alan’s margin and growth.

🔍 What we're looking for

We're looking for an engineering leader who gets excited about building state-of-the-art AI systems and applying them to real-world, high-stakes problems in healthcare.

Leadership experience

  • 3+ years leading engineering teams, with a track record of building high performers.

  • You partner with other product functions as a true equal: you shape the roadmap, name trade-offs honestly, and help the team commit to what it can actually deliver.

Technical foundations

  • Experience establishing engineering excellence standards, with the ability to guide architectural decisions.

  • First-hand experience shipping AI or LLM products to production is a big plus.

  • You're excited and eager to keep writing code. You still review it, and you still ship some yourself.

  • Comfortable with modern development practices and AI-assisted development tools.

What we value

  • Curious, self-starting, humble, collaborative, and eager to grow.

  • You develop people as much as you develop products.

  • Ex-founders are typically a great fit in our team.

Mission alignment

  • Healthcare technology and innovation excite you

  • You understand that great engineering teams are built on psychological safety and continuous learning

But above all, we are looking for high potential and curiosity: make sure to show us this when you apply!

🎯 Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply, as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist. We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

A propos de Lemonway

Lemonway est un établissement de paiement agréé, au cœur de la nouvelle économie européenne.

Nous sécurisons les paiements des plateformes de financement participatif, d’économie collaborative, des marketplaces et des e-commerçants, avec un fort engagement contre la fraude et pour la protection des fonds.

Réglementée par l’ACPR et bénéficiant du passeport européen dans 29 pays, Lemonway est basée à Paris et Hambourg et rassemble 150 Lemonheroes multiculturels et engagés.

Plus de 400 marketplaces nous font confiance. Nous gérons 1,4 million de portefeuilles utilisateurs et avons levé 50 M€ auprès de Breega, SpeedInvest et Toscafund.

Rentable depuis quatre ans et en croissance de +25 % en 2025, Lemonway vise à rester parmi les leaders du paiement en Europe grâce à une croissance saine et durable.

Le Poste

L'équipe est composée d'une Product Manager, un Engineering Manager 2 développeurs BACK PHP et 2 développeurs FRONT (Typescript / React). Intégrée au sein de la Squad MERCHANT, dédiée aux outils et services à destination de nos marchands partenaires, nous fonctionnons en Scrum avec des sprints de deux semaines et une livraison continue.

Voici les principales informations sur l'équipe :

  • L'amélioration continue et la capacité à délivrer une qualité toujours au rendez-vous sont des enjeux très forts au sein de cette équipe.

  • Au sein de la squad MERCHANT, nous développons et maintenons des APIs Backend utilisées par nos marchands pour interagir avec la plateforme de paiement Paygreen by Lemonway.

📌 Les missions principales

Contribuer au développement de notre offre produit

  • Participer au développement de nouvelles fonctionnalités sur les APIs Backend PHP exposées aux marchands.

  • Collaborer avec les équipes produit et les développeurs seniors pour s'assurer que les solutions développées répondent aux besoins des marchands et aux standards de la plateforme.

Participer à la gestion du legacy

  • Analyser et comprendre le code existant pour identifier les zones nécessitant une refonte ou une optimisation.

  • Contribuer aux chantiers de réduction de la dette technique en collaboration avec l'équipe.

  • Participer à la refactorisation du code selon les bonnes pratiques, sous la supervision de développeurs expérimentés.

Contribuer à la documentation et aux process

  • Rédiger et maintenir une documentation technique claire pour les APIs développées.

  • Appliquer les guidelines de développement de l'équipe et contribuer à leur amélioration.

  • Participer à la mise en place et à l'utilisation des pipelines CI/CD pour automatiser les contrôles qualité.

Améliorer la qualité du code

  • Participer aux revues de code et progresser grâce aux retours de l'équipe.

  • Contribuer à l'écriture de tests unitaires et d'intégration pour sécuriser les livraisons.

  • Appliquer les bonnes pratiques de développement backend et monter en compétence sur les enjeux de performance et de sécurité des APIs.


Que recherchons nous ?

  • Une formation en cours (Bac+3 à Bac+5) en développement informatique ou école d'ingénieurs.

  • Des bases solides en PHP et une envie d'approfondir tes connaissances backend.

  • Une première expérience ou connaissance des APIs REST.

  • Une connaissance ou un intérêt pour les bases de données relationnelles SQL/Postgres.

  • Un esprit d'équipe fort : tu sais poser des questions, t'appuyer sur tes collègues et partager ce que tu apprends.

  • Une curiosité technique et une sensibilité à la qualité du code.

  • La capacité à lire de la documentation en anglais.

** Notez qu’on propose un alternance de 12 mois à démarrer en Janvier 2027. Ce point n’est pas modifiable. Si votre école ne vous permet pas d’accepter un contrat d’alternance de 12 mois, nous ne pourrons pas confirmer l’alignement.

Le process de recrutement 

  1. Interview RH

  1. Interview Manager : échange avec l'Engineering Manager et un membre de la squad, pour discuter des missions et des attentes du poste.

  1. Entretien technique : exercice pratique pour évaluer tes bases en développement backend.

Lemonway s'engage à promouvoir la diversité, notamment en favorisant la mixité Femme/Homme et l'emploi de personnes en situation de handicap.

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

As a Senior Sales Engineer at Samsara, you'd be part of a diverse group of both technically and business minded folks working together to bring our unique connected operations technology to customers.  Our daily customer engagements include conversations around logistics/supply chain management, fleet management and maintenance strategies, global asset management, system integrations, and regulatory compliance. This means a successful Sales Engineer at Samsara will develop a thorough understanding of IoT hardware and sensors, hands-on installation/deployment scenarios, carrier networks, cloud infrastructure, and third-party system integrations (via our open API) to ensure the proper technical solution is presented to our customers.  

This is a unique opportunity to support and grow a key market for Samsara in close collaboration with other areas of the business: Sales, Marketing, Product Management, Technical Support, and Customer Success.

This role can be office-based (Paris) or fully remote in France. This role requires travel up to 25% of the time.

In this role, you will: 

  • Become an expert on Samsara products: where the rubber of cutting-edge tech (IoT, AI, computer vision) meets the road of driving digital transformation for physical operations.
  • Articulate to prospects how businesses like theirs use Samsara today to solve problems common to their industry.
  • Deliver the work products that get deals done. Think discoveries, demonstrations, value assessments, proof of concept implementations, etc.
  • Write scripts against our open API that solve real-world problems for companies that deliver essential services (for example), and document them for your fellow SEs to use.
  • Open the door for deeper entrenchment into accounts (integration, upsell, cross-sell) by becoming a consultant to your customers.
  • Act as a liaison between Samsara's product and sales teams, translating technical feedback and enrolling the right customers in our beta programs.
  • Partner with sales executives to plan, prepare, and execute transactions in rapid sales cycles.
  • Work in multiple levels of the technology stack.
  • Support sales executives ad-hoc queries and emails.
  • Build relationships with third-party partners, such as software providers, systems integrators, and installation partners.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related discipline.
  • 4+ years experience working with customers in a pre-sales, customer success, or customer/product support capacity.
  • Ability to influence stakeholders based on your technical sales acumen and a solid understanding of business processes and change management.
  • Ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
  • Knowledge of MEDDIC/BANT/CoM and/or Value Selling sales concepts.
  • Previous experience managing hardware and/or software product evaluations.
  • Basic understanding of electronics and electrical systems.
  • Experience with the following concepts: technical consulting, cloud software, cloud-connected hardware, computer networking, business systems integration, automation, and control systems.
  • Fluent in French and English
  • Great time management and organizational skills to work on multiple accounts and projects at different stages.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related discipline.
  • Work experience in task automation scripting and transferring data between systems using Bash, Python, JavaScript, or equivalent language.
  • Work experience building solutions leveraging open APIs.
  • Understanding of vehicle diagnostic systems, including Controller Area Networks (CAN bus) and Power Take Off (PTO) applications.
  • Hobbyist interest in working with things driven by electronic systems (car audio installation/classic car restoration, home automation, building things with Raspberry Pi, Arduino, etc.).
  • Consistent track record of success selling complex technical solutions through strategic sales cycles.
  • Experience working with product teams internally and feature request processes.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

About Genesis

We are a full-stack general-purpose robot company, born across San Francisco, London and Paris and bound by a single mission: to make general-purpose robots a reality, unlocking infinite physical labor for the world and freeing people for creativity, exploration and the pursuits they love for their own sake.

We're building the engine that will teach robots to do real work in the real world. We recently unveiled Eno, our wheeled, dexterous robot powered by our GENE foundation model and we are starting to put it to work with real customers.

The role

General-purpose robots learn from real, dexterous human work, the kind of data that does not exist on the internet. We capture it with our own collection hardware: a person wears it, does the work, and the robot learns to do it too.

You will be a senior member of the team scaling our data collection operation in Paris, working closely with our Paris research and engineering teams and with the operation in the Bay Area.

You will help lead the day-to-day execution and quality bar on the Paris floor while remaining deeply hands-on with data collection, teleoperation, task setup, and real-robot testing. You will wear our gloves and cameras, teleoperate our hardware, and take ownership of complex collection requests from setup through execution and quality review.

You will work shoulder to shoulder with our model engineering and research teams, turning their requests into physical demonstrations and feeding what you learn on the floor back to them. You will be expected to operate autonomously, help guide and train other operators and contribute to how the Paris operation evolves as the team grows.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will not just run existing tasks: you will help shape how they are executed, how quality is measured, and how other operators are trained to deliver consistently.

What you will do

  • Help lead the Paris data collection floor. Set the execution and quality bar for day-to-day collection work and help the team scale effectively.

  • Own complex collection setups. Take a loosely defined request and turn it into a working, repeatable collection task, including the setup, fixtures, props, environment, and procedure, with minimal support from engineering.

  • Create high-quality training data. Wear our gloves and cameras, teleoperate our hardware, and produce precise demonstrations that can be used to train our models.

  • Own the full collection workflow. Go beyond collecting the data itself: review and quality-check your work, identify unusable episodes, support annotation, and help ensure that what reaches research is trainable data.

  • Build repeatable tasks. Turn new collection requests into clear, repeatable processes that can be executed consistently by other operators.

  • Partner with research and model engineering. Translate their requests into physical collection tasks, share observations from the floor, and iterate with them on setups and collection strategy.

  • Improve the operation. Identify when a fixture, station layout, procedure, or collection method can be improved and proactively help implement those improvements.

  • Write and improve the playbook. Own SOPs, quality checks, and training materials that allow the Paris operation to scale while maintaining a consistent quality bar.

  • Guide other operators. Help onboard, train, and mentor operators and reinforce consistent execution across the team.

  • Run real-robot testing. Partner with reliability and engineering teams to test robots on the floor, document what you observe, and help surface issues.

  • Own quality. Review your own work and the team's, take direct feedback, and keep raising the bar.

What we are looking for

  • You have done precise, repetitive physical work to a high quality bar and can explain what made your work good and how you measured it. This could include data collection, teleoperation, motion capture, robotics lab work, assembly, fine craft, or another hands-on technical environment.

  • Hands-on robot or glove-based data collection experience is a strong plus, but not a requirement. This kind of data collection is new, and we will teach you our specific tools and approach.

  • You build, not just run. Give you a vague request and a scrappy setup, and you can turn it into a clean, repeatable task with the right fixtures, environment, process, and written procedure.

  • You can operate autonomously. You are comfortable taking ownership of complex collection tasks with limited day-to-day support from engineering.

  • You understand quality beyond collection. You can review your work, recognize when collected data is unusable or below the quality bar, and understand why.

  • You are ready to lead. You have trained, mentored, or led others doing hands-on work and want to help establish the execution and quality standard for a growing team.

  • You work well with research and engineering teams. You can translate their requests into physical collection tasks and turn what you observe during collection into useful feedback.

  • You have exceptional attention to detail. You notice the moment something about the setup, hardware, environment, procedure, or collected data is off.

  • You are technically handy. You are comfortable with Linux, some Python scripting to automate repetitive work, and hardware assembly and troubleshooting.

  • You are comfortable in a fast-moving environment. Hardware, processes, and collection methods will evolve quickly, and you are comfortable adapting while helping improve how the team works.

  • You communicate well in English. You will work daily with teams in Paris and the Bay Area across time zones. French is a plus.

  • Bonus: reliability testing. You have partnered with a reliability or test team on real-robot testing.

Working conditions and role constraints

  • Work takes place in production environments and technical laboratories.

  • Prolonged standing and repetitive hand and arm movements while wearing collection equipment, including gloves, head-mounted cameras, and headsets, for extended periods.

  • Handling and lifting of loads, including props, fixtures, robot equipment, and station equipment, up to 23 kg for station setup and reconfiguration.

Why this role

  • Real ownership. You will have meaningful ownership over how the Paris data collection floor operates and help set the standard the team grows toward.

  • Hands-on leadership. You will remain close to the work while helping guide other operators, improve execution, and raise the quality bar.

  • Build, not just execute. You will take ambiguous collection needs and turn them into reliable, repeatable tasks that can scale across the team.

  • A clear growth path. As the operation scales, this role can grow toward leading or supervising teams of operators or toward broader project and program management responsibilities.

  • The front line of the mission. The data you create, review, and improve is what teaches our robots to work.

Ein kerngesundes IT-Unternehmen erfolgreich in die Zukunft führen.

Unser Auftraggeber ist ein seit bald 40 Jahren erfolgreich etabliertes, inhabergeführtes und vollständig eigenfinanziertes Schweizer IT-Beratungs- und Dienstleistungsunternehmen mit Hauptsitz in der Nordwestschweiz und einer weiteren Geschäftsstelle. Als langjähriger, zertifizierter Partner einer führenden betriebswirtschaftlichen Standardsoftware realisiert das Team von rund 25 Spezialistinnen und Spezialisten integrierte ERP-Gesamtlösungen – von der Beratung und Konzeption über die Implementierung bis zu Support und Hosting. Ein heterogener, treuer Kundenstamm aus KMU, Grossbetrieben, öffentlicher Hand und sozialen Institutionen schätzt die hohe Qualität und Verlässlichkeit. Im Rahmen einer vorausschauenden– Regelung der Führungscrew - die beiden Gründer ziehen sich aus dem operativen Geschäft in den Verwaltungsrat zurück – suchen wir eine führungserfahrene, unternehmerisch geprägte Persönlichkeit.

Aufgaben

  • Operative Gesamtleitung und Steuerung des Unternehmens im Rahmen der strategischen Leitplanken des Verwaltungsrates, inkl. Vorbereitung der VR-Sitzungen.
  • Finanzielle Führung mit Verantwortung für Budgetierung, Liquiditäts- und Abschlussplanung sowie Fakturierung und Controlling in Abstimmung mit Buchhaltung und Revisionsstelle.
  • Durchführen der quartalsweisen Management-Reviews (Kennzahlen, Pipeline, Kundenfeedback) in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Q-Leiter.
  • Führung des Verkaufsleiters und Steuerung der Vertriebsaktivitäten mit Fokus auf Kundenbindung, Neukundengewinnung und Offertwesen.
  • Direkte Führung und Förderung der Bereiche Administration, Buchhaltung, Q-Leitung, Technik/Infrastruktur und Softwareentwicklung sowie Verantwortung für HR-Prozesse und Arbeitgeberpositionierung.
  • Sparringspartner der technischen Teams bei Lösungsentscheiden, IT-Security, Datenschutz (DSG) und internen Projekten.
  • Weiterentwicklung des Qualitätsmanagementsystems nach ISO 9001.
  • Steuerung von Vertragswesen, Versicherungsportfolio und Risikomanagement sowie Pflege der Partnerschaft mit dem zentralen Softwarelieferanten.
  • Pflege der Unternehmenskultur und Repräsentation des Unternehmens gegenüber Kunden, Partnern, Banken und Behörden.

Voraussetzungen

Sie verfügen über eine kaufmännische Grundausbildung mit betriebswirtschaftlicher Weiterbildung auf Stufe FH, HF oder Universität (z. B. Betriebsökonomie, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder eidg. Diplom in Unternehmensführung). Sie bringen einen nachweisbaren Leistungsausweis in der Führung eines Schweizer KMU oder Dienstleistungsunternehmens mit – idealerweise in der IT-Branche – und bewegen sich sicher in Finanzen, Controlling und betriebswirtschaftlicher Steuerung. Eine ausgeprägte IT-Affinität setzen wir voraus; Erfahrung im ERP-Umfeld ist von Vorteil, spezifisches Produktwissen jedoch nicht erforderlich. Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse runden Ihr Profil ab.

Persönlichkeit

Als entscheidungsstarke Generalistin oder entscheidungsstarker Generalist mit kaufmännischem Fundament verbinden Sie unternehmerisches Denken mit einer pragmatischen Hands-on-Mentalität und packen auch im Tagesgeschäft mit an. Sie behalten das grosse Ganze im Blick, setzen klare Prioritäten und bringen einen hohen Qualitätsanspruch sowie ein ausgeprägtes Kostenbewusstsein mit. Mit Integrität, einem gesunden Mass an Bescheidenheit und natürlicher Autorität schaffen Sie Vertrauen und führen Mitarbeitende wertschätzend, situativ und auf Augenhöhe.

Attraktivität der Stelle

  • Gesamtleitung eines kerngesunden, vollständig eigenfinanzierten IT-Unternehmens mit solider Substanz.
  • Grosser unternehmerischer Gestaltungsspielraum bei kurzen Entscheidungswegen und flachen Hierarchien.
  • Mittelfristige Perspektive auf eine unternehmerische Beteiligung.
  • Treuer, breit abgestützter Kundenstamm.
  • Eingespieltes Fachteam und partnerschaftliche Zusammenarbeit mit dem Verwaltungsrat.
  • Arbeitsort in der Region Basel mit der Möglichkeit von einem Tag Homeoffice pro Woche.

We're proud to work with many incredible companies, accelerating their ability to build their products.

We've spent years watching talented engineering teams lose momentum to the same frustrating bottleneck: waiting. Waiting for CI to finish. Waiting for builds to complete. Waiting for tests to run.

After experiencing this pain firsthand at companies of every size, we set out to build the developer infrastructure platform we'd always wanted to use. Something that would seamlessly integrate with our workflows and the tools teams already love—but make everything dramatically faster and more cost-effective.

Today, we're already accelerating hundreds of companies around the world, helping them ship features instead of waiting for infrastructure. We've built something that feels almost magical in its simplicity: change your runs-on line, mount your toolchain cache directory and suddenly your builds are 5x faster.

About the role

As a Security Engineer at Namespace, you'll own and strengthen security across our systems, network, and infrastructure. You'll work closely with engineering and operations to identify vulnerabilities, build security measures and best practices, and ensure security is embedded into how we build and operate.

Our culture

We're looking for people with grit—people who push through ambiguity, take ownership, and keep going when things get hard. You're deeply curious, driven to understand how things work and how they can be improved. Most importantly, you have a strong bias to execution: you don't wait for perfect conditions, you ship, learn, and iterate quickly. If you care about building, moving fast, and making real impact, you'll fit right in.

What you'll do

  • Design and build novel firewalls, intrusion detection systems (IDS), and intrusion prevention systems (IPS) to fortify our servers, networks, and systems

  • Develop security measures to quickly detect and respond to real-time threats and vulnerabilities

  • Develop security-first guidelines and best practices for the entire organization to follow

  • Work closely with operations, developers, and other stakeholders to build and maintain a one-team approach to security

  • Support the sales team with security questionnaires and technical security requirements from customers

What we're looking for

  • Strong security engineering fundamentals, with hands-on experience securing production infrastructure, systems, and networks

  • Experience with network security, firewalls, intrusion detection and prevention, vulnerability management, and threat detection and response

  • Ability to identify security risks and translate them into pragmatic technical solutions

  • Strong understanding of security best practices across modern cloud and infrastructure environments

  • Ability to work closely with engineering and operations teams and embed security into existing systems and workflows

  • Bias toward execution and ownership, with the ability to operate effectively in a fast-moving environment

In dieser vielseitigen Funktion übernehmen Sie eine wichtige Rolle bei der Weiterentwicklung und dem Betrieb einer modernen, Azure-basierten IoT-Webapplikation. Sie konzipieren und skalieren REST-APIs für die Kommunikation zwischen Geräten, Sensoren und Cloudsystemen und sorgen dafür, dass Performance, Sicherheit und Kosten im Cloudbetrieb stimmen. Denn auch in der Cloud wachsen die Bäume nicht unbegrenzt in den Himmel.

Darüber hinaus entwickeln Sie moderne Webfrontends mit Angular, gestalten die Softwarearchitektur aktiv mit und bringen Ihre Ideen bei technischen Entscheidungen und Standards ein. Code Reviews, automatisierte Tests und CI/CD gehören ebenso zu Ihrem Alltag wie die kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Softwarequalität. Bei Bedarf unterstützen Sie auch die mobile Entwicklung mit Flutter. Je nach Interesse und Erfahrung besteht zudem die Möglichkeit, sich in die Softwareentwicklung für Embedded-Systeme einzubringen.

Ihre Sozialkompetenz

Sie denken gerne über den Tellerrand hinaus, übernehmen Verantwortung und lassen sich auch von anspruchsvollen technischen Herausforderungen nicht aus der Ruhe bringen. Sie arbeiten selbstständig, tauschen sich gerne mit anderen Fachleuten aus und verstehen es, Ihre Ideen konstruktiv einzubringen. The Data Understanding team is responsible for creating the high quality datasets and their quantized representation for OpenAI. This includes synthesizing data, building VQ representations, and processing, filtering, deduplication, quality control, and tokenization so it can be used effectively in big model training runs.

About The Role

We're looking to advance how OpenAI builds and understands pretraining data at scale. You'll treat data quality and curation as core research problems: developing new methods to select, combine, and transform data; creating datasets that improve model capabilities; and designing rigorous experiments to understand how data choices and interventions affect model learning and downstream behavior. You'll work closely with frontier models and web-scale data to build evidence for which approaches work and why, then translate successful research into scalable data processing pipelines

We Expect You To

  • Have a strong track record of new or improved ML ideas, through publications, projects, or applied research.

  • Own and drive a research agenda, from choosing the right problems to carrying long-running work through to impact.

  • Be excited by OpenAI’s empirical, collaborative approach to research.

Nice To Have

  • Experience building high-performance deep learning or large-scale data processing systems.

About The Opportunity

We are building a rigorous, verifiable evaluation suite of Terminal-Bench tasks designed to test the limits of large language models on multilingual software challenges. Our goal is to measure multilingual robustness across prompt language effects, non-English data processing, and complex locale/encoding edge cases in terminal workflows.

We are seeking experienced native-speaking software engineers to design, build, and validate these benchmarks. You will create high-signal, high-quality tasks that genuinely test a model's ability to handle multilingual environments without relying on English translation crutches.

Note this is a remote, freelance opportunity

What You’ll Deliver

  • Task Engineering: Evaluating Coding Agents.

  • Asset Creation: Build realistic task environments using datasets and files in your native language. Crucially, these assets must remain in the target language to genuinely measure multilingual handling.

  • Prompting & Translation: finding failure points where AI does not work, in your native language

  • Implementation & Verification: Support the development of robust solutions (reference implementations) and write highly reliable, deterministic verifier scripts (using rubric-based judging only when strictly necessary).

  • Calibration & Execution: Analyze execution logs and calibrate task difficulty (Easy to Very Hard) using standard Terminal-Bench run configurations against various model tiers (Haiku, Sonnet, Opus).

  • Quality Assurance: Participate in a rigorous, 4-layer human quality control process (creation, human review, calibration review, and audit) alongside automated LLM-based checks to ensure fairness, grammatical accuracy, and benchmark integrity.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 1+ years of industry experience in software or prompt engineering.

  • Background: Proven track record at leading technology companies and/or graduation from top-tier engineering universities.

  • Language: Native or near-native fluency, with a deep understanding of its grammar, register, and phrasing rules. High English proficiency.

  • Technical Stack: Strong proficiency in Python, standard shell scripting, and data processing.

  • Workflow: Extensive experience with Terminal/CLI-based development workflows and a working familiarity with coding agents.

  • Domain Expertise: Deep technical understanding of multilingual text processing pitfalls, including:

    • Encoding/decoding robustness and Unicode normalization.

Neural Concept embeds AI into design and simulation workflows so engineering teams make continuous, data-driven decisions instead of waiting on sequential design–simulation–validation cycles. None of that matters until the platform is running inside the customer's environment, on their infrastructure, under their rules.


That is this role. You take an enterprise customer and make the platform real for them: architected, deployed, integrated, cleared by their security organisation, and stable enough that their engineers stop thinking about it. You own that outcome end to end for named accounts, as their primary technical counterpart.

 

What you will do

  • The deployment, from the first architecture conversation through go-live and into steady-state operation.

  • Its integration with the customer's identity, data and engineering systems, and the infrastructure and model serving layer beneath it.

  • The relationship with their IT, security and platform teams: assessments, architecture reviews, and the call when something breaks.

  • The diagnosis when it does break, including when the cause sits outside our own software.

  • The runbooks, post-mortems and playbooks that make the next deployment easier, and the feedback loop into Product.

 

Where you will do it
Managed Kubernetes across the major clouds. On-premises and fully air-gapped clusters with no route to the internet, GPU infrastructure, self-hosted model serving. Customer HPC environments, schedulers, and shared storage under real load.

 

If installing software with no internet access, on hardware you do not control, reads as the interesting part of the job rather than the obstacle, this will suit you.

 

Who you are

You will often be the only Neural Concept engineer in the room. We are looking for someone with:

  • 6+ years deploying and operating enterprise software in production, two of them in environments you did not control.

  • Kubernetes at configuration depth: how chart values become rendered manifests, and why a workload will not start.

  • Identity and SSO fundamentals: OIDC and SAML, clients and credential rotation, redirect URIs, group-to-role mapping.

  • Linux, networking and TLS: DNS, routing, ingress and egress, certificate chains and interception proxies.

  • Kubernetes storage: persistent volumes and CSI, access modes, diagnosing shared storage that degrades under load.

  • Professional customer-facing English, and willingness to travel and work your customers' hours.

Also valuable: regulated or air-gapped deployments · private registries and image mirroring · GPU scheduling and LLM serving · enterprise IdP administration · Terraform and GitOps · Prometheus and Grafana · HPC schedulers · ISO 27001 evidence · Python · PLM, CAD or CAE exposure.

 

You Get

  • Work with a world-class technology team – our engineers are top-notch, and we always aim for excellence.

  • Benefit from a competitive salary and rewarding opportunities as we continue to scale.

  • Thrive in a collaborative, multicultural environment where your work is visible and recognized.

  • Develop professionally alongside talented colleagues who share knowledge freely and support one another.

  • Make a global impact by helping customers shift to AI-assisted design, making innovation faster, smarter, and more sustainable.

  • Balance life and work with remote work or hybrid model (20% remote) —we care about results, not rigid schedules.

 

Where You Will Be

  • Remote from Europe or one of our offices in Switzerland or Munich;

  • Travelling: This position will require travelling to customer location within Europe

  • Start date: ASAP

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and we're committed to building a diverse and inclusive environment where you can thrive.
